overall_summary: Analysis of FACTVERSE performance data clearly shows that 'What If / Extreme Planetary Scenarios' and high-concept space curiosities published within the last 30 days (such as 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?', 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year', and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?') massively outperform older biology, psychology, or standard historical facts in both absolute views and engagement (likes-per-view). Videos utilizing hypothetical second-person survival and mind-bending space extremes secure the highest velocity.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,028 views, 38 likes) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) drive high engagement through immersive peril.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on 'What If You Fell Into...' formats focusing on extreme cosmic environments with high visual contrast.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (980 views, 21 likes) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,027 views, 36 likes) outperform general space facts by presenting counterintuitive physical realities.
winning_patterns.action: Focus on lesser-known exoplanets and weird orbital mechanics rather than broad cosmic generalities.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos such as 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5 views, 0 likes) and 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head' (71 views, 4 likes) show severely depressed velocity compared to space content.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize psychological trivia and song/memory hacks until the channel establishes broader general audience pull.

weak_patterns.evidence: Older or recycled animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (118 views, 0 likes) trail significantly behind high-concept space content in engagement ratios.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid standard textbook animal trivia; pivot animal content exclusively to cinematic survival or extreme evolutionary anomalies.
